> 第八章 捉奸（第1页）
云王皇甫陌轩来的时候，蓝若晴刻意的让紫茉躲避出去。
皇甫陌轩见蓝若晴没什么动静，以为紫茉什么都没有说，也就没再提让紫茉出去的事。
蓝若晴以为这件事情就这样子结束了，谁知事情还是再次发生了。
或许是紫茉一直不甘心蓝若晴被蒙在鼓里，也或许是皇甫陌轩根本就不在意蓝若晴的感受，又或许是蓝汐冷刻意挑战她在皇甫陌轩心里的地位。
这一天黄昏以后，蓝汐冷又跑来王府，并且再次与皇甫陌轩留宿客房。
当紫茉气喘吁吁的跑到房间里，拉着蓝若晴往外跑的时候，一头雾水的蓝若晴被突如其来的情景吓倒了。
紫茉什么也不说，任凭蓝若晴怎样问她也不回答，只是死命的抓住蓝若晴的手拉着她拼命的朝着客房的方向跑。
当蓝若晴接近客房，心里隐约的明白了些什么。
难道……是皇甫陌轩又与蓝汐冷……蓝若晴不敢再想下去，也不想再想，很显然的，结果是她所害怕的。
因为蓝若晴在意皇甫陌轩，因为蓝若晴不想失去蓝汐冷。
跑到其中一间客房门前，紫茉站住，用力的推开房门。接着，紫茉喃喃自语道：“怎么会这样？怎么会是这样？怎么会变成这样的？”
屋子里放了几十种草药，蓝汐冷在与一个花白长须的老者在磨草药，很显然，面积不大的房间里，没有地方可以躲着皇甫陌轩。
蓝汐冷看到蓝若晴与紫茉来，抬手用衣袖擦了擦额头的汗说：“姐姐你来啦？”低下头继续她未完成的工作，“本想着今天天色已晚，就不打扰你了，待明日早晨再去给姐姐请安呢。这次我找来了一位名医，据说，胡大夫医治好了很多不能成孕的女子。就心想着，请来给姐姐看看。也许能医好姐姐的顽疾也说不定。这不，胡大夫带着他新采摘的草药一起来的，我想和胡大夫在今晚把草药都磨好，这样明日给姐姐诊断完，就可以直接用药了。”
看看跪在一旁的胡大夫，再看着满头汗水却依然用力磨药的蓝汐冷，蓝若晴的泪水不争气的流了下来。跑过去抓住蓝汐冷的手说：“汐冷，这些粗活让下人们做就好，你是名门闺秀，平日里娇生惯养的，怎么能做这些。瞧瞧，这嫩白的小手上，都磨出血泡了。”
拉着蓝汐冷坐在床边，蓝若晴接着道：“陌轩也真是的，你来了也不告诉我，还安排你住在这客房里。吃晚饭了吗？看你这一头汗，姐姐看着心疼死了。”
抱住蓝汐冷，蓝若晴心里的愧疚感油然而生。
就在刚刚，蓝若晴还在怀疑这个女人与她的男人偷情，却未想到她所做的一切都是为了自己。我真该死，不该相信紫茉的一面之词就怀疑汐冷与陌轩。
就在蓝若晴觉得对不起蓝汐冷的时候，伏在蓝若晴肩头上的蓝汐冷，目光凛冽的瞪着紫茉。

如果目光可以杀死人的话，那么，紫茉的早已是千疮百孔，不知被她杀死几百几千回了。

The latest chapter of The Reborn Daughter Wushuang_Chapter 8 Catch the Rape Page 1_The Reborn Daughter Wushuang Ruffian Snow_Hot Novel Network
>Chapter 8 Catch the adulterer (Page 1)
When Prince Yun Huangfu Mo Xuan came, Lan Ruoqing deliberately asked Zi Mo to avoid him.
When Huangfu Moxuan saw that Lan Ruoqing made no movement, he thought that Zimo didn't say anything, so he didn't mention letting Zimo go out again.
Lan Ruoqing thought the matter was over like this, but unexpectedly it happened again.
Maybe it was because Zimo was unwilling to keep Lan Ruoqing in the dark, maybe because Huangfu Moxuan didn't care about Lan Ruoqing's feelings at all, or maybe because Lan Xileng deliberately challenged her position in Huangfu Moxuan's heart.
After dusk that day, Lan Xileng came to the palace again and stayed in the guest room with Huangfu Moxuan again.
When Zi Mo ran into the room panting and pulled Lan Ruoqing out, the confused Lan Ruoqing was frightened by the sudden scene.
Zi Mo didn't say anything, and no matter how Lan Ruoqing asked her, she didn't answer. She just grabbed Lan Ruoqing's hand and pulled her to run towards the guest room.
When Lan Ruoqing approached the guest room, she vaguely understood something in her heart.
Could it be that... it was Huangfu Moxuan and Lan Xileng again... Lan Ruoqing didn't dare to think about it anymore, and she didn't want to think about it anymore. Obviously, the result was what she was afraid of.
Because Lan Ruoqing cares about Huangfu Moxuan, and because Lan Ruoqing doesn't want to lose Lan Xileng.
Running to the door of one of the guest rooms, Zimo stopped and pushed the door open hard. Then, Zi Mo murmured to herself: "How could this happen? How could it be like this? How could it become like this?"
There were dozens of kinds of herbs in the room, and Lan Xi was grinding herbs with an old man with a gray beard. Obviously, there was no place to hide Huangfu Moxuan in the small room.
When Lan Xileng saw Lan Ruoqing and Zimo coming, she raised her hand and wiped the sweat from her forehead with her sleeves and said, "Sister, are you here?" She lowered her head and continued her unfinished work, "I thought it was getting late today, so I wouldn't bother you, and I would go to greet my sister tomorrow morning. This time I found a famous doctor. It is said that Dr. Hu I have cured many women who were unable to conceive. I thought, please come and see my sister. Maybe it can cure my sister’s chronic illness. Doctor Hu came with his newly picked herbs. I want to grind the herbs with him tonight so that I can use the medicine directly after the diagnosis. "
Looking at Dr. Hu who was kneeling aside, and then at Lan Xileng who was sweating but still grinding the medicine hard, Lan Ruoqing's tears flowed down unsatisfactorily. He ran over and grabbed Lan Xi Leng's hand and said, "Xi Leng, just let the servants do these menial tasks. You are a noble lady and you are usually spoiled. How can you do this? Look, there are blood blisters on these white little hands."
Pulling Lan tide Leng to sit by the bed, Lan Ruoqing continued: "It's true that Mo Xuan didn't tell me when you came, and even arranged for you to stay in this guest room. Have you had dinner? Seeing how sweaty you are, my sister feels very distressed."
Holding Lan Xileng in her arms, Lan Ruoqing felt guilty in her heart.
Just now, Lan Ruoqing was still suspecting that this woman was having an affair with her man, but she never thought that everything she did was for herself. Damn it, I shouldn't have doubted tide Leng and Mo Xuan just because I believed Zi Mo's words.
Just when Lan Ruoqing felt sorry for Lan Xi Leng, Lan Xi Leng, who was leaning on Lan Ruoqing's shoulder, stared at Zi Mo with stern eyes.
If looks could kill, then Zimo's body was already riddled with holes, having been killed by her hundreds of thousands of times.
